prompt.alinti: Don't let your AI agent write another line of code until you've installed these five free GitHub repos.
The first is Skill Inspector, NVIDIA's own scanner with over 18,000 stars.
You just point it at any skill before you install it, so nothing you add ever quietly leaks your API keys.
When your agent says it's done, Reticle will open your real app, test it, and hand you the exact lines to fix, so you never ship a broken feature.
It stops your agent rambling and building stuff you've never asked for.
And on CodingTask, it spends less than half the tokens, so you stop paying for fill-ins.
The fourth is UISkills, with over 9,000 stars.
It gives your agent the playbook real design engineers use for spacing, motion, and accessibility, so your app stops looking like every other AI-built website.
It's a set of code rules that automatically reject the lazy pattern AI loves to write, so Sloppy could never even make it into your project.
So if you guys want all five, just comment Repos down below, and I'll send you the link directly.
